metadata.dataset: NASA DONKI Space Weather Catalog & Mars Weather Environmental Sensors
metadata.source: NASA Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI) & REMS/MEDA Teams

hazards.name: Solar Particle Event (SPE - Coronal Mass Ejection)
hazards.mitigationStrategy: Retreat crew to regolith-shielded bunker (>50cm cover); safe-mode non-essential avionics.
hazards.historicalExample: Halloween Solar Storms of October 2003 / August 1972 Apollo-era flare.
hazards.formula: Dose = Integral(Flux(E) * S(E) dE), Sintered regolith HVL = 18 cm
hazards.source: NASA Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) / DONKI
hazards.instrumentOrMission: SOHO LASCO & GOES Space Environment Monitor

hazards.name: 14-Day Lunar Night Cryogenic Freeze
hazards.mitigationStrategy: Ensure nuclear Kilopower base-load or sufficient battery reserve with multi-layer insulation.
hazards.historicalExample: Surveyor 1 and Apollo lunar surface experiment packages surviving extreme cold soak.
hazards.formula: Q_loss = A * (T_int - T_ext) / R_insulation, Heating = max(0, Q_loss - P_internal)
hazards.source: NASA LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment

hazards.name: Mars Regional Atmospheric Dust Storm
hazards.mitigationStrategy: Stow sensitive optics, switch to nuclear or battery reserve, deploy electrostatic dust-repulsion shields.
hazards.historicalExample: Global 2018 dust storm that ended the 15-year Opportunity rover mission.
hazards.formula: I = I_0 * exp(-tau / cos(theta)), Dust layer reduction factor = (1 - delta_dust)
hazards.source: NASA Mars 2020 MEDA (Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer)

hazards.name: Sporadic Hypervelocity Micrometeorite Impact
hazards.mitigationStrategy: Deploy Whipple shields and sintered regolith berms around pressurized habitats.
hazards.historicalExample: LDEF (Long Duration Exposure Facility) orbital impact crater surveys.
hazards.formula: P_penetration ~ v_impact^1.44 * rho_p^0.5 * d_p^1.05 (Christiansen Whipple equation)
hazards.source: NASA Meteoroid Environment Office (MEO) / Marshall Space Flight Center
